steps: Claude Code commits to the project. Each commit is signed by Claude's own wallet on Arkiv.
Antigravity says “continue”. Gemini reads Claude's work and picks up the task. The curve between lanes is the handoff.
Gemini reads a file with an instruction meant for AIs: “ignore all previous instructions…”, and relays it.
The content check stops it. It's revoked on Arkiv, and no other AI receives it.
The write it asked for is outside Gemini's ENS scope, so it's blocked. Every commit is checkable: signer = ENS address.
